name: Phosphate / potash
uses: Fertiliser is the main use of both; phosphate also goes into animal feed and industrial chemicals.
why_it_matters: Brazil's agriculture imports most of its potash and phosphate, and Chinese and Western producers compete to supply it; the deposits in Brazil and Peru are the regional alternative.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures
